title: I used Claude and Codex to build a necromancer game in Unity. Here's the base-building side.
author: ApartmentWest6722
selftext:
Gravewave is my Unity 6 project for Android. This daytime clip shows skeleton workers gathering resources and walls defining the necropolis boundary.



I used Claude and Codex to work on the game's design and implementation. The 3D units and buildings come from KayKit assets, while some UI illustrations and promotional artwork were generated with AI.



For the generated UI art, the pipeline uses a magenta background, removes it, then imports the resulting sprites into Unity. Editor scripts rebuild the scenes and prefabs, so the work includes asset integration and gameplay systems as well as generated images.



The Android build is currently awaiting Google Play review. Sharing a look at how I combined AI code assistance, existing 3D assets, and generated UI assets in one project.
